A7 done, commit ad2fcdc. `./gradlew assembleDebug lint test` green on the
first attempt: 0 lint errors, same 23 pre-existing warnings as A5/A6. 69
unit tests / 14 suites, all passing.

Design decision for A8 (add-item/edit-item dialogs, next ticket): the Add
item button and each row's edit icon are wired to
ListScreen(onAddItem, onEditItem) callbacks that Nav.kt currently passes
as no-ops. A8 should NOT need to touch ListViewModel/ListScreen's
grouping or toggle logic at all — just replace the two no-op lambdas in
Nav.kt's LIST_PATTERN route with real dialog-opening logic (mirroring how
OverviewScreen's FAB opens an inline AlertDialog via its own VM state).
The edit icon's contentDescription is "Edit <item name>" if A8 needs to
target it in Compose tests.

Testing technique worth reusing: Compose's SemanticsActions.GetTextLayoutResult
accessibility action lets you read a Text composable's *actually resolved*
TextStyle (color, textDecoration, etc.) in a Robolectric Compose test
without screenshot testing:
```
val results = mutableListOf<TextLayoutResult>()
node.config[SemanticsActions.GetTextLayoutResult].action?.invoke(results)
val style = results.first().layoutInput.style
```
No test-only hooks needed in production code, works because every Text
composable registers this semantics action by default. Used this for the
checked-row strikethrough/red-color assertion in ListScreenTest.

Also worth noting for A8/A9/A10/A11: `ItemRow` in ListScreen.kt is
`private` (file-scoped), so if a later ticket wants to reuse the same row
rendering (e.g., registry view in A11 showing all statuses), either
promote it to `internal` or accept a small amount of duplication — Notes'
registry view has a status chip that todo-list rows don't, so it may not
be a straight reuse anyway.

IMPORTANT cross-session note: this repo currently has a second, separate
agent session actively working the Web epic in the SAME working tree
(not a git worktree) — confirmed via `gittoc claimed`/`gittoc log`
showing T-21 through T-26 (W1-W5 + a dev-TLS-server ticket) all closed
by "claude" during this ticket's work, plus live uncommitted changes in
web/ (vite.config.ts, ListPage.tsx, etc.) that weren't mine at commit
time. Any future Android ticket's commit MUST stage files by explicit
path (`git add android/...`), never `git add -A`/`git add .`, or it will
sweep up and commit the other session's in-progress web/ work.
